pages.text:
Dark, speckled sand in patches in the sand and gravel of beaches, rivers and deserts, near the surface. Dig it with a shovel.
The Sifter separates it: the sand back, Monazite (30%; honey-brown, with thorium and the rare earths, a little radioactive), Zircon (40%; pale gold-brown) and a little Iron Dust (15%). The Arc Crusher grinds Monazite and Zircon into their dusts.
Thorium and zirconium are for the reactors to come.
